info.about: Animaniacs: The Great Edgar Hunt is an action-adventure video game, released in North America, Europe and Australia in 2005. It is based on the cartoon series Animaniacs from Warner Bros. and features the same voice actors for the main characters.
info.trivia: Yakko, Wakko and Dot hunt for 44 stolen Edgars, the game's parody of the Oscars, scattered across the Warner Bros. studio lot.
info.why: Only the GameCube version came to North America: the PS2 and Xbox editions stayed in Europe and a planned US Xbox release was scrapped.
